categories.main_business_segments: Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in the production process quality detection and control solutions sector. Its main business segments include online automated measurement and control systems and machine vision intelligent inspection systems. These products serve industries such as new energy batteries, films, non-woven fabrics and sanitary materials, papermaking, and are expanding into the semiconductor field.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company’s core technologies encompass X/β-ray sensor technology, microwave moisture detection, spectral measurement, scanning frame detection, embedded high-speed data processing, closed-loop control, and machine vision detection technologies including high-speed line scan cameras and FPGA-based image processing. It integrates multi-disciplinary technologies such as nuclear physics, microwave technology, embedded data processing, and electronic measurement to develop high-precision sensors and intelligent detection algorithms. Production follows an order-driven model with standardized component stocking, involving custom mechanical parts and in-house design.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are leading enterprises in the new energy battery sector, film, non-woven fabric and sanitary materials, and papermaking industries. The company has established stable partnerships with prominent clients such as Hive Energy, Sunwoda, EVE Energy, Qingshan Holding, and others in the battery industry, as well as Foster and Jinwei Machinery in the film sector. The products are also sold to markets including the United States, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Turkey.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company’s operations and sales are primarily concentrated in mainland China, with expanding overseas sales to countries including the United States, Vietnam, Indonesia, Malaysia, and Turkey. The headquarters and main production base are located in Hangzhou, Zhejiang Province.
categories.supply_chain_position: Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology operates mainly as a midstream supplier, providing core components such as sensors and intelligent detection systems to downstream manufacturers in various industries. It is evolving from a system supplier to also being a supplier of core sensor components, enhancing its position in the supply chain by integrating upstream component development with downstream system integration and service.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment, focusing on upgrading online automated measurement and control systems and machine vision intelligent inspection systems. Strategic R&D directions include AI software development, AI training platforms, AI smart cameras, semiconductor wafer defect detection, optical thickness measurement, and automotive assembly line inspection technologies. It aims to build a dual-technology platform with proprietary core components and expand into semiconductor and integrated circuit quality inspection fields.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of customized equipment and systems tailored to client production processes. The company employs a cost-plus pricing model and collects payments in stages aligned with order signing, delivery, acceptance, and warranty periods. It also provides system components and maintenance services, contributing to revenue.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the machine vision sector, major competitors include IsraVision AG (Germany) and Wintriss Engineering Corporation (USA). Zhejiang Shuangyuan Technology’s equipment performance is comparable to these global leaders, especially in new energy battery applications. In process control, it competes with international giants like Honeywell, ABB, and Thermo Fisher but has established a leading domestic position with advanced technology and strong customer relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 386.23 million, a 10.01% decrease from the previous year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 86.86 million, down 34.92%. R&D investment increased by 30.14% to RMB 41.51 million. The company’s total assets were about RMB 2.67 billion with net assets of RMB 2.13 billion. Despite revenue decline due to industry investment slowdown, the company maintains a solid financial base and continues to invest in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its dual core technology platforms—online automated measurement and control systems combined with machine vision intelligent inspection systems—offering integrated quality detection and control solutions. Proprietary sensor technologies, advanced AI algorithms, and high-precision embedded processing enable superior detection accuracy and real-time closed-loop control. Its ability to provide customized, integrated solutions reduces customer communication costs and downtime, enhancing operational efficiency and product quality across multiple industries.
